text:
marta: Follow-up from Valence postmortem. Incident recap: brief tenant isolation during edge failover caused by a combination of sticky NAT state on Valence appliances + rapid re-advertise from peering that created a transient asymmetric path. Need owners for remediation, CI tests, monitoring, and customer coordination. Assigning items below.

hiro: I can do the peering/route work. Plan: implement route dampening w/ per-peer thresholds, add a 20s re-announce suppress in our peering agent, and add a small de-dup pass in route-prop. Will open PR + short rollback snippet. ETA: PR by Thu EOD.

sana: I'll run the on-prem audit with Valence ops. Checklist: conntrack dump, NAT sticky timeout, firewall session-aging, firmware/kernel versions, iptables/ebtables state. If firmware is implicated we ask vendor for a hotfix or mitigations. Need Valence maintenance window.

ellis: I will own CI/blueprints validation. I'll add an e2e that simulates sticky NAT + asymmetric path and a nightly chaos job against dedicated staging. Also add a lightweight BFD hold-time test. ETA: branch in 6 days.

vika: Intro DM to Valence ops sent and filed ticket INC-6001. Added tentative maintenance slots and got initial appliance model info.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-6001 "Valence peering / NAT sticky-state investigation" — assignee: net-ops — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6001

marta: Monitoring request: add Grafana dashboard + alerts for three signals: route_flap_rate, nat_sticky_eviction_rate, and asymmetric_forwarded_packet_rate. Alert if route_flap_rate > 3/5m OR nat_sticky_eviction_rate > 0.5% OR asymmetric_forwarded_packet_rate > 0.05% in 5m. @hiro can you add panel + alert?

hiro: Yep. Draft queries to start with:

```
# route flaps per peer
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="valence"}[5m])) by (peer)

# nat sticky eviction ratio
sum(rate(nat_sticky_eviction_total{customer="valence"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(nat_session_total{customer="valence"}[5m])))
```

I'll wire alerts to #incidents and page on critical. Will include a remediation runbook in the alert text.

sana: Note: Valence appliances show a vendor-specific NAT "sticky-bit" feature that keeps bindings longer than conntrack expects; vendor FW v4.2.0 flagged. Vendor support said fix might be in next minor release but no ETA. I'll ask for a supported mitigation (conntrack prune helper or session-aging override) and capture options in INC-6001.

ellis: For CI I'll mock the vendor sticky behavior so we don't touch customer infra. Test will replay the packet timing from the pcap captured during the incident and assert no duplicate-forwarding. I'll add the test to the PR validation pipeline for peering changes.

marta: Short-term mitigation discussion: 1) route holdback + dampening (hiro) 2) conntrack-pruner shim (ops-tooling) 3) customer-side session-aging adjustment (vendor/Valence ops). Who can prototype the shim?

ellis: I can prototype a safe conntrack-pruner that runs in dry-mode first and logs candidates. If approved we can add a prune flag for maintenance windows only. ETA prototype: 4 days.

vika: Valence agreed to a Tue 02:00-03:00 PT maintenance window to run audit/dry-run. They want runbook + PR links before sign-off.

marta: Action summary (added to postmortem doc):
1) hiro — route dampening + 20s re-announce suppress + de-dupe in route-prop (PR -> #PR-1423) — ETA Thu EOD
2) sana — on-prem audit + vendor escalation (INC-6001) — ETA Mon next week
3) ellis — conntrack-pruner prototype (dry-run) + CI e2e & nightly chaos job — ETA Fri next week
4) vika — customer coordination + maintenance window confirmation — ETA tomorrow (confirm runbook)
5) monitoring dashboard + alerting (owner: hiro) — ETA Wed

marta: Please update INC-6001 with milestones and paste PR/CI links as they land. Quick sync scheduled Tue 09:00 PT for 15m to confirm progress. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
